title: Empty segment emission property
statement: Fix a Boolean parameter $\ell$, natural numbers $n,i,B,k$, and an oracle assigning a Boolean answer to each of five deciders and each bit string. If the initial configuration $a$ satisfies $P$, then the empty segment starting at $k$ satisfies the emission property from $a$ with postcondition $P$.
